questions.stem: Using the Holliday-Segar method (100 mL/kg/day for the first 10 kg), what is this infant's daily maintenance fluid requirement based on the usual weight of 9 kg? Record your answer in mL/day.

rationale.correct: 100 mL x 9 kg = 900 mL/day, about 38 mL/hr, before replacing the deficit.

questions.stem: Which infection control actions should the nurse take for rotavirus? Select all that apply.

options.text: Contact precautions with gown and gloves
Hand washing with soap and water
Dedicated equipment such as a stethoscope
Teach that rotavirus vaccine prevents severe disease in siblings
Share toys with other children in the playroom

questions.stem: At discharge, for each statement by the parent, indicate whether it shows understanding or needs more teaching.

rows.text: "I'll give ORS after each loose stool."
"I'll come back if there are fewer than 4 wet diapers a day."
"I'll keep feeding the usual formula."
"I'll dilute the formula with extra water to be gentle."
"I'll give homemade salt water if we run out of ORS."
